threats.title: Credential stuffing against sign-in
threats.description: An attacker replays leaked email and password pairs against the sign-in endpoint.

mitigations.text: Rate limit sign-in attempts per account and per IP.
Check new passwords against breached password lists.

threats.title: Note created for another user
threats.description: A user changes an owner field in the request body to write into another user's notes.

mitigations.text: Take the note owner from the session, never from the request.

threats.title: Notes of another user returned
threats.description: Changing the note id in the URL returns a note owned by someone else.

mitigations.text: Look up notes by id and owner together.

threats.title: Note deletion not attributable
threats.description: Deletes are not logged, so a user can deny deleting shared evidence.

mitigations.text: Log note create, edit and delete with the user id and time.
